### 2026-10-15 – ## Started working on PONGO!!

**12h**

## Started working on PONGO!!
> TL;DR: Brainstormed the idea for a simple handheld console utilizing a Arduino Nano, Started on back plate design.
---
So first things, I had to choose a CAD software, had a few options, and initially I was going to use onshape, since I've used it before for a simple model. But I wanted to learn how to use a new software. I discovered freeCAD and it looked very promising. So I went ahead and installed it. And I started by watching a tutorial, the video from deltahedra was a great one.

![Screenshot_20261013_210930](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/1f7e2d410d38866e03909bb44ae424f90b33943a8e26434e7efb4cd65e0a6786.png)

So I followed it by first defining some dimensions, using sketch's, which basically are how you bring the idea from a 2D drawing to a 3D design.

![Screenshot_20261013_213304](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/b5e9a189ac9ddc83d4c4e85ba186566dbf6e25ee352b35c258b5e600c9f6d2ba.png)

Then after like a fewwww hours got that done, it teached me a looot from sketchs, constraints, dimensions, holes, fillets and muuuch more. And plugins.

![Screenshot_20261013_222437](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/e225fb46f3414263ea59c3e00aacd170722d38d5b64be763d0fd201ab09831dc.png)

![Screenshot_20261015_214123](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/03413fb3ce6e0d16ac075599a745ae7dcab5c4cd14ed3a81e929caa2e6e143d6.png)

After completing the tutorial, and learning a bunch of new stuff, I started first by creating REPO files like the .gitignore and more.

![Screenshot_20261014_213916](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/f128c958cb475f6c6e4757990f202fdedf4fd650482223d107a734e07e5e0a15.png)

Then pushed everything to a new repo named [PONGO](https://github.com/rayvn-42/PONGO).

![Screenshot_20261014_214735](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/569ab9a139fd9ba10a4103555b681fcd63a9ddefb5634610f52b2934c74ac130.png)

Then I started by adding a box shape for the back plate, and basically used the pocket tool to extrude the box to its thickness, then added a new sketch on the front face of the box and used it to inset an inner rectangle giving the shape a 2mm wall size (84x140x28mm, wall size of 2mm).

![Screenshot_20261014_225815](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/eb05249deb6997cc02e0609793331903a346397c57298925e634f24e658f86a3.png)

![Screenshot_20261014_230403](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/d3bfacadcc27de2f9c5aa4a9229c9b5cbb3fca47fd1d6371de270aae08587603.png)

Then next I added a sketch for the screen screw poles, with holes (using the hole tool), then extruded the screw poles so that they give just enough space for the display to sit right about the front plate.

![Screenshot_20261015_000231](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/f2918fa9c3b23331958606ecb5c901bbfb7681000eb5c012ec2f521dc0d3b17a.png)

![Screenshot_20261014_235834](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/bdd0990f51076c8369c2dc5f455d69ce43cc7a6230fb02fad3c270b42009ce38.png)

![Screenshot_20261015_000740](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/c26000a09b24090413c63fa7412a75b52ebaebd0aca6caf90578fd600444dc79.png)

Then finally renamed the items that I added just so I know what everything is

![Screenshot_20261015_001643](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/8cfce9e0b2d33c5434f2a49d4b57305f4ac71942f7f917d34446cdf2a3feb371.png)

And that was it for the first entry, done a bit of stuff, but still very early. Next I'll probably figure out some compartments for the other components, and add screw holes for the front plate. Also for the screws, I decided to use heat insert.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/f2399e0e0d9b46bf953426b348618b9b755b44cc0ffc5c9f47fdf5c5e4fa3b06.png)

:)

### 2026-10-17 – ## Sooo, This entry is for 3 days

**13.6h**

## Sooo, This entry is for 3 days
> TL:DR: Finished Back Plate design, worked on Front Plate, dimensions constraint to M2 Screw inserts.
---
So first things first, I started by reinforcing the OLED mount poles, since they're long, they can easily break so I added lateral supports that connect to body walls

![Screenshot_20261016_152333](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/5a48ab57d802e4368d90304300f0d40f186b3f4a8ea183cd4a1f73581698e8ab.png)

So That was that, next I wanted to add a hole at the bottom of the body for the nano's port, so first I just checked out the correct dimensions for the MINI USB port size, then just added a simple rectangle cut-out. I made sure to keep space so that the arduino correctly fits, and also some padding for the ports size (tolerances and stuff).

![Screenshot_20261016_154241](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/96e159a4b89a77df6d4922c73608b8aeb74e478ad96188cf8624973df9872330.png)

![Screenshot_20261016_154410](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/1ca6aa625bd50ad26bd5c5790e998fb7cfaaaaf234d2e6fa9edcedd1ea0eba69.png)

Then I wanted to put some supports to hold the arduino Nano, I looked at what designs people did.

![Screenshot_20261016_154547](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/cafa13176162b8443ba133169a77048e5db15c8ad5a38f795376110ecaedc297.png)

But then I just decided I'll make a simple block at the bottom and poles to hold the arduino's pins.

![Screenshot_20261016_155421](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/c8d146ecc1a1f31e5df4c8ef82a2db8256306a9cc8a2d93c3d178fb7f0f9589b.png)

![Screenshot_20261016_161209](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/10760b7ffaf0f1a12c7d94cdaddef691f99904c17b9dd645d54e1f55e4c3e2d7.png)

Next was screw holes to that I can assemble the front and back plates together. I spaced them just kinda randomly but added constraints to make sure that they're symmetrical.

![Screenshot_20261016_233607](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/1fcae09cdd58293f8c9f7342a1d3e85b99f10bf2c4ef689f3737433bec9f688a.png)

Then so that it holds out, I first looked at the screws dimesions and head type.

![Screenshot_20261016_234335](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/7120849d26c69b2bbd50bb0ee93e74ee2b664cea4a7c5ed84aa571529800acfb.png)

Then used freeCAD's hole tool to make the whole with the correct head type.

![Screenshot_20261016_234025](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/2449ae84daab592744d62a150557df8d7b6987ff2e2aa325aebd9a2f78653d5d.png)

![Screenshot_20261016_234035](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/698de570bdc0c59db17b0335571f003bb71840fb74b5726fb358ec8eaac6f7cc.png)

And that was it for the back plate, and this was the projects tree.

![Screenshot_20261017_001033](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/6759f827498065a901a3b7e52a126b7d3b189eaeebc55e244cfd7b5aaf4ea40a.png)

Then created a new body, and with a smaller size for tolerance and stuff (like .25mm smaller), its just a simple rectangle

![Screenshot_20261017_014731](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/91a43b9e87052ece12bf42de27a0609f31a23873fe33e9b28d291334a2536fdc.png)

![Screenshot_20261017_015059](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/84d1955e76915733f30695c0ae162065fc0f574dbf664aa5052e8f672e193ab7.png)

Then for the buzzer, I wanted to make like a custom shape, like a face or something

![Screenshot_20261017_025637](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/a56bb596090c3614a17b655a1e255cd916ac99da81421bd0033c432f4f83bb8b.png)

![Screenshot_20261017_030815](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/9327706fcda62ec2536903a0d445b85fd5eb4024faaf1908feb3a49e0b58f569.png)

 soo, uhm I should never do that ever again 😭

![Screenshot_20261017_033036](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XoBihhfZo6FAvvRPA5lxGMbSZAmBagkB/837399453b0bb644cee65f36a68deb9f9ca7fc1bcb04e457d483ee75f19beadc.png)
